news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.0% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: Shivam Autotech Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 1.2 billion in funding from Alpha Alternatives Holdings Private Limited
news.body: Shivam Autotech Limited announced a private placement to issue 12,000 Secured Redeemable Optionally Convertible Debentures having a face value of INR 100,000 each for aggregate gross proceeds of INR 1,200,000,000 o November 29, 2025. The debentures may be converted into equity shares, solely at the option of the Investor, in one or more tranches within a period of 18 (eighteen) months from the date of allotment and will carry an interest rate of 10%. The transaction has been approved by the board of directors and is subject to the approval of the shareholders, regulatory authorities and approvals of BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited.
